description: This file implements the embedding bag operations optimized for Apple Metal with Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch. It includes functions for forward, backward, and related utilities for embedding bag layers, utilizing Metal shaders and streams.

methods.name: promoteIndicesAndOffsets
methods.description: Utility function to promote indices and offsets tensors to a common type.

methods.name: _embedding_bag_mps_impl
methods.description: Main implementation function that performs the embedding bag operation using Metal shaders, for different modes such as sum, max, etc.

methods.name: _embedding_bag_mps
methods.description: Public interface to call the MPS embedding bag operation.

methods.name: _embedding_bag_forward_only_mps
methods.description: Wrapper function for forward-only embedding bag operation.

methods.name: _embedding_bag_dense_backward_mps
methods.description: Function to compute the backward pass for dense embedding bag using MPS.

methods.name: _embedding_bag_per_sample_weights_backward_mps
methods.description: Function to compute the backward pass for per-sample weights in embedding bag layer.
